decisions.reason: The cleaning-method change does not alter the independent leak-prevention requirements; this candidate already captures the separate leakage clause from the same message.
Spout removability or flushability does not change the valve mechanism, closed-valve behavior, or controlled flow requirements.
The cleaning requirement does not change the spout's bottom location, barista-facing orientation, or pouring goal; the removable-or-flushable choice is owned by the sanitary fluid-path Requirement.
The spout cleaning method has no effect on machine branding, displayed name, or placard wording.
The source specifies how the spout must be cleaned and does not change bowl capacity or bowl form.
Removable or flushable spout cleaning does not modify the splash-control target for mixing operation.
The sanitary fluid-path change has no effect on the machine's color scheme.
The spout cleaning method does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The general layout and CAD deliverable remains valid unchanged; propagating this product-level cleaning detail into the artifact Requirement is not necessary.
